description: schedule-fixed's copybook read odoslide, in a variable-length dataset: the table holds as many entries as the record's own count states, the item behind it moves with that count, and the schedule over the positions is the same text in both layouts. Three records, of four entries, one and three. The single-entry record reaches only the arm scheduled for occurrence one and carries no slack run at all; the three-entry record reaches the work arm twice and carries two. So which runs a record has is the count's here while which position takes which arm stays the descriptor's, and a consumer that paired the runs back up by counting them against the declared maximum is wrong at the second record. The pair with schedule-fixed is the entry's point: one copybook, two readings, two descriptors that differ in the table's repetition and in nothing about the variant, which is what says a schedule is available under both readings.
